title: San Diego Electric Bike Rentals
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Boost your ride with a pedal assist electric bike!

Bike through the historic Gaslamp Quarter and ride towards the Embarcadero, which has the best views of San Diego

See all the downtown gems including the USS Midway, Embarcadero Marina Park, Billionaire Row, Maritime Museum, Bob Hope Memorial, Tuna Pier and Seaport Village!

Riders should be at least 13 to rent e-bikes.
